<thought>Using the standard DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C14H11O6 (no N or halogens), we calculate DBE = (2*14 + 2 - 11)/2 = (28 + 2 - 11)/2 = 19/2 = 9.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the most plausible integer value for this compound is 9.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
